steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction, matching the reverse-auction scenario.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with the very large quantity in the first line item.
Complete the required pricing-sheet fields before scheduling and publishing.
Verify the first row retains the requested large quantity as displayed by the sheet.
Check that the sheet has no NaN, undefined, raw IDs, server error, or page crash after rendering the large quantity.
Invite one available QA vendor so the auction can be published.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
